mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort_order, c.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.author = #{author}) AS article_count FROM category c ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT id, name, sort_order FROM category ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

author, create_time, update_time, status, category_id FROM article WHERE author = #{author} AND category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
